comment: The like-or-unlike look of the rotation round (ALGEBRA.md #the-rows-against-nature (f); #the-hypotheses-under-their-own-names, The sign holder rotates the two-part record; HIGHLIGHTS.md, There is no sense), its three uncharged worlds, the look's control, a GameBoard reading and no finding: every number of the three worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, lays their bodies with the generator (tools/pixel_mode.py, each body's sense) and writes the blind expectation file before any run. One chain of `length` Nodes (x open with the faces' layer one Node deep, y and z folded); two bodies of `quanta` quanta of the plane family `plane` (matter's pair as a plane), declared one Node each at `at`, 64 Links apart, laid rotating by the generator as whole bodies in the senses a world names, on the universe `uncharged` (the rule's own rows, examples/events/rule.json, at T 36,000 with the plane family reading no holder of the sign: its `reads` the two holders of the content alone, so that it neither reads nor sources the charge, the coupling nil by the declaration, the owner's decision of 2026-10-02 on the declaration's read; the holder's level weight 10^6 kept as the row's), for the world `uncharged_pair` and for the same two single bodies alone, each at its Node on the same chain (`at` of the world). Two forces move the pair's bodies beside their own spreading, the mutual pull of the binding holder and of gravity, G; a single body carries neither. The six charged worlds of the look (like, unlike, their plain controls like_plain and unlike_plain on the universe plain.json, and the charged single bodies alone_first and alone_second on the universe turning.json), declared without a mode file and refused at load, were removed on 2026-10-03 at the owner's word, what does not load is deleted; turning.json stays as the charged universe the paper names (the energy line: 100 x 36,000 x 4,000 = 400 x 6,000 x 6,000), with no world on it; the readings of 2026-10-01 stand in the law's row (f) as the readings' history.
